gen-megrim-gf-comme: Futuristic and angular, Megrim draws every line in one hairline measure. Comme follows with a smooth, modern body whose lowercase fills most of the letter height, so nothing clogs.
gen-megrim-gf-cossette-texte: Megrim stands up top with angular, futuristic strokes that all end at one measured thickness. Cossette Texte then fills in below with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height, giving the headline something steady to lean on.
gen-megrim-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads open and clean, its small letters wide-mouthed. Megrim above it keeps its joins from thinning where strokes meet, so the angular display lines and the broad sans-serif body each hold their own ground.
gen-megrim-gf-fresca: Megrim's c is as open as a bent paperclip, and that single gesture sets its angular, futuristic tone. And Fresca, a modern sans-serif with no calligraphic thinning, keeps its counters connected to the space outside.
gen-megrim-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans reads crisp and professional, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height line. Funnel Sans pairs with Megrim's angular display lettering best when the body text is given a bit more size than usual, since its sans-serif strokes stay thin.
gen-megrim-gf-gafata: Contemporary and professional, Gafata stacks a tall band of lowercase under short stalks, with each e wide-eyed. Megrim's thick-only outline is the sharper counterpart.
gen-megrim-gf-geist: Megrim opens with angular, futuristic lines, every stroke ending at one measured thickness. Geist takes over below with a quiet, level beat in sans-serif, its words forming solid blocks rather than a jagged skyline.
gen-megrim-gf-georama: Approachable and neutral, Georama has a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart and barely rising capitals. Megrim supplies the angular display edge above it.
gen-megrim-gf-gidole: Megrim's c is open as a bent paperclip, and its angular, futuristic strokes make it the louder voice. Gidole does the quieter job, a plain sans with terminals held apart like scissor blades and a high-set midline.
gen-megrim-gf-heebo: Megrim looks like pipe cleaner bent into angular, futuristic letters, each stroke ending at the same measured thickness. Heebo carries the reading below, a sans with a tall central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing in.
